pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, polygonal dark regions with soft, blurred pixel gradients at the edges. Patch spatial area is large on the flank, transitioning to more elongated and compressed geometries toward the base of the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological network. Junction nodes are prominent where three to four patches meet. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, with wider intersections and thinner connecting segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck. The pixel definition of individual hair tufts is moderate to low due to image resolution.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural interruption or dip is visible in the mane line at the junction where the neck meets the shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark avian subject, likely an oxpecker (Buphagus sp.), on the mid-lower flank region.
